# Resources: Brand identity

Archives to see how a form has already been solved, publications that critique identity work, real guideline documents, studio case studies, and the tools for naming and trademark checks.

Access reads `cost · agent access · licence`. Agent access: `static` = a plain web fetch can read it; `js` = needs a real browser; `blocked` = bot protection or a login wall, send the user the link instead; `unknown` = could not be reached from the maintainer's network when last checked (not proof that it is down). `login` = content is gated. Tier: `S` first place to look, `A` strong, `B` niche or with a clear weakness.

## Logo archives

Search the client's initial, shape family and industry before sketching. Similarity to an existing mark is a legal risk, not only a taste issue.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Logobook](https://www.logobook.com) | Archive of the world's classic logos, browsable by letter, shape, object and designer; images can be saved directly | Browse by the client's initial or by shape family (circle, arrow, animal) to see how a form has already been solved | free · static | S |
| [Logo Archive](https://logo-archive.org) | Mid-century modernist marks documented with designer and year | Reference for reductive, geometric construction | free · js | A |
| [Logosystem](https://logosystem.co) | Contemporary logos indexed by symbol, letter and designer | Use /symbol to compare treatments of one form | free · static | A |
| [Logopedia](https://logos.fandom.com/wiki/Logopedia) | Logo evolution timelines for thousands of brands | Use for rebrand equity audits: what stayed constant across redesigns | free · blocked | A |
| [Logo Design Love](https://www.logodesignlove.com) | David Airey's long-running blog on logo craft, process and case studies | Read the process posts before presenting logo options | free · static · slow | A |
| [Emblemetric](https://www.emblemetric.com) | Quantitative analysis of logo trends from trademark data | Evidence on how common a colour or form is in a category | free · static · slow | B |
| [LogoLounge](https://www.logolounge.com) | Large member-submitted logo database; the annual trend report is free | Read the trend report to know which cliches to avoid | paid · static · login | B |

## Identity reviews and rebrand coverage

Learn the vocabulary of identity critique and how systems extend beyond the logo.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Brand New](https://www.underconsideration.com/brandnew/) | The definitive chronicle and critique of identity work and rebrands; low-cost subscription | Search the archive by industry before starting a rebrand | paid · static · login | S |
| [BP&O](https://bpando.org) | In-depth reviews of identity and packaging projects with a critical eye | Read the reviews for the vocabulary of identity critique | free · static | S |
| [The Brand Identity](https://the-brandidentity.com) | Contemporary identity projects and type releases, well photographed | Use /projects for current identity aesthetics | free · static | S |
| [Logo News (标志情报局) (zh)](https://www.logonews.cn) | The leading Chinese-language chronicle of logo changes and new identities worldwide and in China | Search a Chinese brand's name for its identity history | free · static | S |
| [Identity Designed](https://identitydesigned.com) | Identity case studies written by the studios themselves | See how studios explain and sequence their own work | free · static | A |
| [Mindsparkle Mag](https://mindsparklemag.com) | Daily curation across branding, web and motion | Broad scanning of current identity work | free · static | A |
| [Rebrand Gallery](https://rebrand.gallery) | Library of brand refreshes and rebrands with their reveal videos | Filter by feel (/feels/<vibe>) or industry; watch how the reveal is staged | free · static | A |
| [古田路9号 (zh)](https://www.gtn9.com) | Chinese brand-design community and portfolio platform | Reference for domestic brand-design taste and pricing of visual language | free · static | A |

## Brand guideline collections

Open three guidelines from a similar industry and compare their contents before writing one.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Brand Guidelines](https://brandguidelines.net) | Collection of official brand guideline documents (Twitch, Instacart, Asana and more) | Open three from a similar industry and compare their table of contents | free · js | A |
| [Branding Style Guides](https://brandingstyleguides.com) | Large archive of brand manuals and style guides, many as PDFs | Filter by category under /category/style-guides/ | free · static | A |
| [Standards](https://standards.site) | Platform for web-native brand guidelines with public examples | Study how a living guideline site is structured | freemium · static | A |
| [Standards Manual](https://standardsmanual.com) | Reissues of landmark graphics standards manuals (NASA, NYCTA, EPA) | Previews show how rigorous systems were specified | paid · static | A |
| [Brandfetch](https://brandfetch.com) | Logos, colours and fonts of companies via search and API | Quick way to collect a competitor line-up | freemium · static | A |

## Naming and trademark search

An agent cannot clear a mark. These tools find obvious conflicts; a professional search is still required.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [WIPO Global Brand Database](https://branddb.wipo.int) | Worldwide trademark search including image similarity | Run an image search on a candidate mark; a lawyer's clearance is still required | free · blocked | S |
| [TMview](https://www.tmdn.org/tmview/) | Trademark search across many national and regional offices | Cross-check names and marks by class | free · js | A |
| [中国商标网 (zh)](https://sbj.cnipa.gov.cn) | Official Chinese trademark search | Check names and marks for the mainland market | free · static · login | A |
| [Onym](https://guide.onym.co) | Curated guide to naming: process, tools, references | Follow its process when the brief includes a name | free · static · slow | A |
| [Igor Naming Guide](https://www.igorinternational.com/process/igor-naming-guide.php) | Taxonomy of name types (functional, invented, experiential, evocative) with evaluation criteria | Classify candidate names before judging them | free · js · slow | A |
